content.short: HyperSwap is a concentrated liquidity AMM and one of the principal exchanges on HyperEVM.
content.description: HyperSwap is an AMM on HyperEVM where users swap, provide liquidity and earn fees from the pools they supply. It positions itself as the chain's liquidity hub, with a stated community of more than 18,000 users.
content.meta: One of HyperEVM's most used AMMs and a common routing hop for aggregators.
